# Logstag Documentation

> Logstag is a data reliability platform for the data layer: it monitors PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis and Valkey and turns what it sees into insights. Built by Techmind Partners.

This is the product documentation for Logstag (logstag.com). Logstag is not Logstash, the log pipeline from Elastic, and not LogStage, the Scala logging library. A lightweight agent runs in the customer environment, collects operational metadata and database statistics, and sends them to Logstag, where they power health views, alerts and insights.

## Overview

- [Introduction](https://docs.logstag.com/): What Logstag is and how the documentation is organized
- [Architecture](https://docs.logstag.com/architecture/): Agent-based architecture and the data flow from agent to web application
- [Supported engines](https://docs.logstag.com/supported-engines/): The engines Logstag supports and what it monitors on each
- [Product areas](https://docs.logstag.com/product-areas/): Map of the product's main views, in sidebar order

## Security and privacy

- [Security model](https://docs.logstag.com/security-model/): Dedicated monitoring users, least privilege and read-oriented collection; Logstag is not a database proxy
- [Data collection and privacy](https://docs.logstag.com/data-collection-and-privacy/): What the agent collects (operational metadata and statistics) and what it does not copy (application table rows)
- [API keys](https://docs.logstag.com/api-keys/): How agent API keys authenticate agents to a Logstag organization

## Setup

- [Getting started](https://docs.logstag.com/getting-started/): Minimum setup path for a Logstag agent
- [Agent installation](https://docs.logstag.com/agent-installation/): Install the agent as a Linux systemd service, a Windows Service, a container or a foreground process
- [Agent configuration](https://docs.logstag.com/agent-configuration/): The agent's TOML configuration file and per-target settings
- [Managed targets](https://docs.logstag.com/managed-targets/): Database targets that also need cloud provider metadata

## Database engines

- [PostgreSQL](https://docs.logstag.com/engines/postgresql/): PostgreSQL setup and what Logstag collects from it
- [Microsoft SQL Server](https://docs.logstag.com/engines/mssql/): SQL Server setup and what Logstag collects from it
- [MongoDB](https://docs.logstag.com/engines/mongodb/): MongoDB setup and what Logstag collects from it
- [Redis and Valkey](https://docs.logstag.com/engines/redis-valkey/): Redis and Valkey setup and what Logstag collects from them
- [Oracle](https://docs.logstag.com/engines/oracle/): Oracle setup and what Logstag collects from it

## Product guides

- [Dashboard](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/dashboard/): The organization dashboard: KPI strip, trend charts and latest alerts
- [Insights](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/insights/): Beta. Background detectors that surface query regressions, N+1 patterns and workload anomalies against each database's own baseline
- [Alerts](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/alerts/): How alerts work: templates, policies, severity and operational workflow
- [Database Explorer](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/database-explorer/): Per-database detail views
- [Activity Explorer](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/activity-explorer/): Sessions, connections, wait events and blocking chains
- [Query Explorer](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/query-explorer/): Query detail views and statistics
- [Schema Explorer](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/schema-explorer/): Schemas, schema changes and permissions
- [Data Inventory](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/data-inventory/): Classifies schema metadata to find sensitive-data categories, risk and exposure
- [Assets](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/assets/): Registering database servers, agent setup and connection state
- [Reports](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/reports/): The reports catalog and PDF report requests
- [Users](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/users/): User management, roles and permissions
- [Integrations](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/integrations/): Connecting Logstag workflows to external systems
- [Audit Logs](https://docs.logstag.com/product-guides/audit-logs/): API access and user activity tracking

## Operations

- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.logstag.com/operations/troubleshooting/): When the agent isn't registering, data is missing or views look stale
- [Agent logs](https://docs.logstag.com/operations/agent-logs/): Using agent logs to investigate registration, connectivity and collection issues
- [Upgrades](https://docs.logstag.com/operations/upgrades/): Planning, performing, verifying and recovering from agent upgrades
- [Performance and interval tuning](https://docs.logstag.com/operations/performance-and-interval-tuning/): The agent's collection frequency tiers and how to tune them
